name: zmodel_material_has_aux_data
description: zModel_Material::HasAuxData reports flag-bit and cycle aux-data ownership.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?HasAuxData@zModel_Material@@YIHPAUzModel_MaterialPartial@@@Z at 0x480c80 currently fails with 23 unmasked mismatches after masking 0 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 29 bytes, the VC object symbol is 32 bytes with 8 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/zmodel_material_di_clone_dependencies/verify/480c80_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x480c80 validates nonzero return for material flag bits 0x0200 or 0x0400, or a non-null cycle pointer, and zero otherwise.
The native smoke verifies flag-only, cycle-only, and no-aux material cases.
